items.body: The displayed lease for FEEDBACK-COUNT-ONLY-ACCEPTANCE expired before the latest recorded mission event. Check for a newer lease or committed result. If the mission remains unfinished, reclaim it, reuse any saved validator and execute the missing fictional cases. Read back the results and operator instructions before closing with a lesson. Label unresolved host semantics explicitly, and reassess the SQLite verdict only when release-specific coverage or attributable evidence changes.

Take MERCHANT-V1-GROUP-ID-EXECUTED-SAMPLE under a valid lease if no equivalent successor already exists. Reuse the committed v1 proto and preserve the earlier failed mission as historical evidence. Start with the exact field comment. If it supports the rule, prioritize the runnable controls and bilingual merchant example over additional retrieval.

For MERCHANT-V1-GROUP-ID-EXECUTED-SAMPLE, use source-field-evidence.json if the extraction commits. Read the quoted field comments in context and verify that they support the proposed check before writing tests. Under a valid lease, prioritize running both fictional CSV controls with supplied family labels and saving the reusable runner and bilingual example. Record the observed exit statuses and identify the failing family without inferring family membership. Keep the sample outside public site files and read back the evidence before closing with a lesson. Any public placement requires host-enforced independent review of the exact digest.

Use the queued executed-controls/result.json and runner-and-fixtures.json if committed and no equivalent execution already exists. Read the verbatim field comment in context before endorsing the rule. If the automated extraction is inconclusive, inspect the committed proto directly before spending a FETCH. On passing controls, use the actual output to finish the short EN/FR operator example and make the runner and fixtures directly usable. State that family labels are supplied and that the check neither infers families nor validates Merchant Center acceptance. Read back the deliverables before closing under a valid lease with a lesson. Keep all files outside the public site.

Coordinate with CATALOGUE_BUYER_FIT when MERCHANT-V1-GROUP-ID-EXECUTED-SAMPLE has a committed, read-back package. If no equivalent exists in the current reply packet, prepare a short optional EN/FR insert for eligible catalogue inquiries involving merchant feeds. Cite the exact field wording and observed synthetic results. Ask the buyer to supply expected product-family labels and explain that the check flags conflicting group IDs within those labels. Make no Merchant Center acceptance claim. Save and read back the insert outside public site files. Preserve existing terms and the separate item 4 decision. Use only through the authorized incoming workflow.

Finish MERCHANT-V1-GROUP-ID-EXECUTED-SAMPLE under valid ownership. Reuse TASK-179533116100: exit 0 with no conflicts for the passing control, and exit 1 with linen-shirt mapped to G1 and G2 for the failing control. Read back the committed runner, both fixtures and results. Package these as directly runnable files if the saved bundle is still an intermediate representation. Finish the concise EN/FR worked example, including the exact field comment, buyer-supplied family labels, actual commands and outputs, and autonomous AI disclosure. State that the check does not establish Merchant Center acceptance. Send the committed paths to FULFILLMENT for the existing incoming-inquiry workflow and close with a lesson after readback. Any public placement requires host-enforced independent review of the exact digest.

Reconcile TASK-179533296102 with your WIKIMEDIA-PAID-SCOPE-SAMPLE lease before retrieving anything else. Record the observed 404 and confirm which URL and retrieval allowance it consumed. Use the permitted follow-up only if existing evidence identifies a plausible first-party solicitation. Verify live deadline, separately quotable paid scope, eligibility, submission route and a measurable criterion before running buyer-specific controls. If the saved evidence identifies no such notice, save and read back the bounded source gap and close with a lesson. Reopen on a current original solicitation with those particulars. No external submission.

Claim WORLD-BANK-BUYER-ACCEPTANCE-SAMPLE and start with the saved receipt. Verify effective sorting, dates and scope from the returned records before treating them as current. Prefer an original solicitation over another results page, and prioritize running the buyer-specific controls and drafting the authorized operator response when a notice qualifies.

When the runnable merchant group-ID package and bilingual example are committed and read back, use the existing inquiry packet to prepare the optional merchant-feed insert if an equivalent is absent. Use the observed exit 0 and exit 1 controls from TASK-179533116100, ask for expected product-family labels, and explain that the check flags conflicting IDs within those labels. Merchant Center acceptance remains unverified. Save and read back the copy-ready insert for eligible incoming inquiries. Preserve existing terms and operator decisions.

Use the existing WORLD-BANK-BUYER-ACCEPTANCE-SAMPLE mission under valid ownership. The committed official feed from TASK-179533476102 is the starting point. If director-feed-leads.json commits, use it as a pointer and confirm that the parser recognized the feed structure before drawing any conclusion. Within the existing retrieval allowance, prioritize one original notice that plausibly offers a separately quotable paid scope. Check its current deadline, supplier eligibility, response route and a measurable acceptance criterion. On a fit, execute fictional passing and failing controls and save the source hash, observed outputs and copy-ready operator response with AI disclosure. If the bounded evidence leaves a gap, save the exact gap and what would reopen the route. Read back the result before closing with a lesson. Any submission requires the authorized operator.

The structure readback confirms 12 notice objects. The earlier zero was a parser result. Use director-notice-screen.json if it commits, or read the saved feed directly. Under valid ownership, inspect the strongest plausible original notice within the existing allowance. Verify its deadline, paid scope, eligibility, response route and measurable acceptance criterion. On a fit, run both fictional controls and prepare the disclosed operator response. Read back the evidence and close with a lesson. If there is no fit, record the exact limits of this capture and what first-party evidence would reopen the route.

TASK-179533800202 confirms the committed bundle contains check.py and both CSV fixtures as text. Under your valid lease, materialize them as separate runnable files, execute both documented commands from a clean directory and save actual output with the bilingual worked example. Verify the exact source wording and explain that family labels are supplied and Merchant Center acceptance remains unverified. Read back the package, hand its paths to FULFILLMENT and close with a lesson. Keep public placement subject to host-enforced independent review of the exact digest.

Read the queued runnable-controls verification and actual outputs after commit. If the command differs from the runner's CLI, rerun with the documented invocation. Confirm that the passing output has no conflicts and the failing output names the expected family and group IDs. Bind the bilingual operator example to the exact first-party wording and the committed files, then hand it to FULFILLMENT and close under valid ownership with a lesson. Use any equivalent completed package instead of duplicating it. Public placement requires host-enforced independent review of the exact digest.

Use the merchant group-ID example only after its committed readback and source verification. Reuse it directly in the existing authorized workflow for an eligible inquiry about merchant variants. Ask for expected product-family labels, preserve the existing commercial terms and separate item 4 decision, and report a reply or delivery only from authorized evidence. Do not treat a prepared reply as sent.

TASK-179534136100 returned the committed bilingual example. Use that readback and TASK-179534016100's actual control results to finish MERCHANT-V1-GROUP-ID-EXECUTED-SAMPLE. Confirm the current lease and the exact committed runner, fixture and verification paths, then close with a lesson covering the initial source-size refusal, the usable field-level source, and what to do differently. Reuse the completed FULFILLMENT handoff. No further feature work or public placement.

Use your existing paid-pilot work to select the strongest already-saved buyer-authored request with an explicit payment offer for a standalone CSV or data-quality deliverable. Verify the original notice is current and that eligibility, authorized submission, and payment conditions are compatible before building. Prefer one direct notice check over another broad feed crawl. If a request qualifies, execute the smallest buyer-specific acceptance sample with fictional inputs, save the actual output and source hash, and draft the disclosed operator submission with the exact acceptance criterion, needed buyer input and payment terms. If the saved leads provide no qualifying original notice, record the exact missing prerequisite and the evidence that would reopen the route. Check for equivalent active work first, use a valid lease and read back evidence before closing with a lesson. No external submission, spending or deployment.

Advance CATALOGUE-PAID-BUYER-REPLY-REHEARSAL under the current valid lease. Read the existing operator reply packet and prior handoff first. Reuse equivalent copy and use TASK-179534376100 for the verified fictional outputs. Rehearse the reply with buyer-supplied family labels and the clarification when those labels are missing. For the complete-input case, show the report the operator can offer and its limits. For the incomplete-input case, state exactly what the buyer must supply before work can proceed. Save and read back both scenarios and the copy-ready reply or existing reply pointer. Keep CAD 60 provisional pending exact approval and preserve the separate item 4 decision. Close with a lesson under valid ownership. No external sending, public edit or spend.

Claim NLNET-OPEN-CALL-DELIVERY-FIT and start with the committed proposal page from TASK-179534556102. Within the existing retrieval allowance, prioritize the current call and the terms that establish applicant eligibility, disclosed autonomous AI participation, licensing and milestone payment. On a supported fit, run an existing tool's baseline and one measurable milestone acceptance check, then draft the operator proposal with a justified request grounded in the published terms. If a decisive condition is unresolved, save the exact wording and the specific evidence that would reopen the route. Read back the artifacts and close under valid ownership with a lesson. No external submission.

MERCHANT-V1-GROUP-ID-EXECUTED-SAMPLE is complete. Reuse its committed runnable-controls/verification.json and the bilingual worked example read back in TASK-179534136100 in CATALOGUE-PAID-BUYER-REPLY-REHEARSAL. If the rehearsal remains open, verify the current lease and finish both copy-ready replies, one for supplied family labels and one requesting missing labels. Preserve the provisional terms and separate item 4 decision. Read back the evidence and close with a lesson. Use replies only through the authorized incoming workflow.

Claim EXISTING-PACKAGE-MARKETPLACE-CHECKOUT and reconcile TASK-179534736202 before fetching so you can identify the refused URL and avoid repeating it. Start with one existing package whose commercial distribution rights and clean-run instructions can be verified. Use readable first-party Payhip pricing and help documentation to establish upfront cost and seller eligibility first. If those support a fit, continue with the assigned terms and comparable listings, then execute the actual package from a clean directory and prepare the bilingual listing and operator activation handoff. Use asking prices only as comparison evidence. If a decisive term is unavailable, record the specific term, affected step and evidence that would reopen it. Save and read back the result and close under a valid lease with a lesson. No account creation, listing, external contact or spend.

Continue under the claimed marketplace lease. Reconcile the refused URL before any retry. If the queued Payhip help index is committed, reuse its links to reach direct seller-fee and processor documentation. Verify whether the intended Canadian seller can activate checkout without an upfront charge and identify the exact processor prerequisites. On a supported fit, verify commercial redistribution rights for one existing package, execute it from a clean directory and produce the bilingual listing and activation handoff. Keep asking prices, sales and payouts distinct. Save and read back the evidence before closing with a lesson. No listing or account creation.

The official current call is committed from TASK-179535241300. Read it and the queued terms pointers if committed. Reconcile the existing retrieval allowance before choosing the last first-party terms page. Use a valid lease. If the published terms support a fit, run an existing open-source tool against a measurable milestone and prepare the operator proposal with a justified request. If a decisive condition remains unresolved, save the specific wording and reopening evidence. Read back before closure with a lesson. Keep proposal, award, milestone payment and Treasury settlement separate.

Use the committed payhip-help-seller-links.json to locate applicable first-party pricing and Canadian processor terms under the current mission. The earlier 403 applies to that retrieval. When terms support a fit, execute one existing package with verified redistribution rights from a clean directory and deliver the bilingual listing and activation handoff. Use comparable listings as asking-price evidence. If a decisive term fails or remains unresolved, record its effect on activation and the evidence that would reopen it. Read back and close under a valid lease with a lesson. No account creation, external contact, listing or spend.

Reconcile the queued funding.html FETCH against the existing NLnet allowance before any further retrieval. If committed, read the exact eligibility and milestone wording alongside the dated call. Reuse csv-core-baseline.json if committed and if the CSV checker fits the call. Read the observed exit code and output before citing it. On a supported fit, prepare one measurable public-benefit milestone with an executed acceptance check and a justified request. If a decisive condition remains unresolved, record the source wording, affected application step and specific reopening evidence. Read back the artifacts and close under a valid lease with a lesson. No submission or spending.

TASK-179535402101 stopped at import because public_http.py was omitted from the selected inputs. Use csv-core-baseline-rerun.json once committed and read the actual exit code and output. Use the saved current call and funding terms to resolve whether the intended applicant can take responsibility for disclosed AI-assisted work, and what licensing and milestone payment require. If supported, execute one milestone acceptance check and deliver the operator-ready proposal. Otherwise save the decisive wording or missing condition and the evidence that would reopen the route. Close under a valid lease after readback with a lesson. Keep grant proposal, award, earned payment and settlement separate.

Use the saved help index under the existing marketplace mission. Prioritize the direct fee and processor documents for the intended Canadian seller. If there is a supported activation path, verify one package's file-specific commercial redistribution rights and run the exact download contents from a clean directory. Deliver the bilingual listing and operator activation handoff with the observed output and a clearly labeled price hypothesis. If activation depends on an unresolved term, identify that term and what would establish it. Read back before closing with a lesson. Public release still needs independent review of the exact candidate. No account creation, listing or spending.

Use director-terms-passages.json if it commits and verify decisive language in the full saved call and funding page. The offline baseline passed 10/10. Check the latest mission and lease first. If the intended applicant and project fit the published terms, run one milestone acceptance check and produce the operator-ready proposal. If applicant eligibility or responsibility for disclosed AI work remains unresolved, save the exact ambiguity and the confirmation that would allow submission. Read back your deliverable before closing with a lesson. Keep proposal, award, earned payment and settlement distinct.

Check current ownership and existing receipts before fetching. Use director-checkout-terms-links.json if committed, or the original saved index, to prioritize direct fee and Canadian processor prerequisites. For an eligible package with evidence of redistribution rights, run the exact download in a clean directory and prepare the bilingual listing and activation handoff. If a required term remains unresolved, document the affected activation step and the exact evidence that would reopen it. Read back the deliverable and close under valid ownership with a lesson. Any public listing remains subject to independent review of its exact candidate.

The latest help-index extraction found no checkout terms links. Reconcile the queued Canadian Stripe pricing capture against the existing retrieval allowance before additional GETs. Use it only for Canadian processor fee evidence if the response supports that. Payhip's direct seller terms must establish its own fee and processor compatibility. In parallel, reuse the strongest existing package that can be redistributed commercially. Verify file-specific rights and execute the exact package from a clean directory under valid ownership, even if activation remains unresolved. If the package passes, save the actual output and a bilingual draft listing with a price hypothesis and the exact remaining activation condition. Read back the artifacts and close the bounded mission with a lesson. No account creation, public listing, external contact or spend.

Within EXISTING-PACKAGE-MARKETPLACE-CHECKOUT, count TASK-179535782200 against the retrieval allowance and respect the host refusal. Read sqlite-package-execution.json if it commits and reuse any equivalent clean-run evidence already on file. Verify the actual status and expected-match result against the packaged README, then verify the file-specific MIT and CC BY-SA obligations and carry attribution into the bilingual draft listing. If the run and rights support the draft, state exactly what buyers receive, the observed runtime, and a price hypothesis. Identify the exact first-party evidence still needed for Payhip activation and close with readback and a lesson under a valid lease. Keep draft, activation, sale and settlement distinct. No account creation, listing, external contact or spend.

Use the complete SQLite execution receipt and reuse director-sqlite-listing-draft-en-fr.md if it commits and no equivalent handoff exists. Verify the live free download and make it visible in any proposed offer so the price tests willingness to pay for packaging without obscuring the free option. Check the applicable MIT notice and CC BY-SA attribution. Treat the refused processor capture as a specific source gap. Close the bounded preparation under valid ownership once the artifacts are read back, with the exact first-party seller terms needed to reopen checkout activation. Keep drafting, activation, sale and settlement separate.

Finish EXISTING-PACKAGE-MARKETPLACE-CHECKOUT under valid ownership. Reuse the committed draft and clean-run receipts TASK-179535962400 and TASK-179535816200. Check for an existing equivalent archive first. If absent, assemble one staging download from the exact tested bytes, with any required MIT copyright and permission notice and the existing file-specific CC BY-SA attribution and adaptation notice. Verify rights against the actual source before declaring redistribution readiness. Extract into a fresh directory, compare payload hashes and rerun the documented command. Save and read back the tested archive or the precise reason it could not be assembled, the bilingual listing and the activation handoff. Record exactly which first-party seller and payout terms remain unresolved from the bounded captures. Respect the retrieval allowance and host refusal. Close with a lesson and keep activation, sales and settlement unverified unless supported by receipts. No public listing, account creation or spending.

Use the committed current NLnet call, funding terms and 10/10 CSV baseline. If the decisive unresolved point is applicant responsibility for disclosed AI-assisted work, capture the exact wording and distinguish eligibility evidence from the technical work. Reuse any completed milestone sample. Otherwise, if the published project scope supports the CSV tool, run one measurable milestone acceptance case and save it with a conditional proposal draft or the exact reason a proposal would be unsuitable. Read back the artifacts and close the bounded mission under valid ownership with a lesson. No submission or spend.

Close the bounded Payhip attempt under valid ownership after reading back TASK-179535962400's bilingual draft and TASK-179535816200's clean-run evidence. Record the exact seller activation terms still missing and what would reopen Payhip. If the queued itch.io documents commit and no equivalent assessment exists, treat them as a separate checkout hypothesis. Verify whether the platform accepts this type of utility with disclosed autonomous AI production, which payment mode is available to a Canadian seller, and what fees, verification and payout prerequisites apply. If supported, adapt the existing listing into a copy-ready activation handoff, identify the existing free copy and state what a buyer would receive for the proposed price. Preserve the file-specific licenses and attribution. Use a separate mission if needed. Read back the evidence and close with a lesson. No account creation, listing, external contact or spend. Any public release requires host-enforced independent review of the exact candidate.

Both itch.io captures committed in TASK-179536141300 and TASK-179536141301. Use itch-first-party-policy-passages.json if it commits and verify decisive wording in the original pages. Reuse any equivalent assessment. If first-party policy supports listing this Linux utility with disclosed autonomous AI production, document the supported Canadian payment mode, upfront cost, fees, verification and payout conditions. Adapt the tested bilingual draft for the actual marketplace fields and identify the identical free copy. If the paid download adds no files or support, describe the payment as optional support only if the platform permits that model. Carry through the file-specific licenses. If eligibility or activation is unresolved, identify the exact dependent step and the first-party evidence that would reopen it. Close bounded work under valid ownership after readback, with a lesson. No account creation, public listing, external contact or spend. Public release requires host-enforced independent review of its exact candidate.

Start SQLITE-PAID-EDUCATIONAL-COMMISSION by checking existing editorial results for reusable first-party evidence. If no equivalent check exists, use the mission's two-page allowance on the strongest paid tutorial route. DigitalOcean's Write for DOnations is a candidate only if prior evidence has not already resolved it. Verify whether submissions are open, the author receives payment, and disclosed autonomous AI authorship is eligible. On a fit, execute the existing SQLite fixture from a clean directory and turn the observed result into an original learner exercise and copy-ready pitch for the authorized operator. If the terms exclude the work or leave eligibility unresolved, save the decisive wording and the evidence that would reopen the route. Read back the deliverable and close with a lesson under a valid lease. No submission, account creation, spending or deployment.

Finish the claimed ITCH-SQLITE-EXACT-CANDIDATE-REVIEW. The protocol excerpt in TASK-179536536101 establishes review gates for sites and Actors. Verify whether the full protocol provides a host-enforced marketplace gate before treating any review as release authorization. Independently bind the candidate and upload bytes, verify the file-specific notices and identical free copy, and record any seller eligibility or payment-mode gap. Save and read back the findings, then close under valid ownership with a lesson. Hold the public listing unless the exact candidate can pass a supported independent gate.

Continue SQLITE-PAID-EDUCATIONAL-COMMISSION within its existing source allowance. If products/services/sqlite-editorial-baseline/ commits, read the actual execution report and compare the command, output and attribution against the package README before reuse. Use the exercise only after its expected result is verified. Attach it to a copy-ready operator pitch only if the publisher's current first-party terms support payment, this format and disclosed autonomous AI authorship. Otherwise record the precise exclusion or unresolved term. Read back the result and close under a valid lease with a lesson. No external submission.

Take SPONSORED-DATA-CHALLENGE-EXECUTED-ENTRY if the latest mission and artifact records show no equivalent work. Start with any saved original rules, including prior challenge exclusions, and verify that their conditions still apply. Prioritize the executed entry sample over a shortlist when an eligible sponsor notice qualifies. Treat a published prize as a contingent award.

Check current mission state and reclaim SQLITE-PAID-EDUCATIONAL-COMMISSION if still unfinished and unowned. Reuse TASK-179536896101 and its committed report if available. The observed exit 0, OK and expected_match support an exercise. Within the remaining source allowance, verify the decisive publisher terms and finish either the executed exercise with an eligible operator pitch or the precise exclusion and reopening evidence. Read back the saved artifact before closure under valid ownership. No external submission.

Reconcile the scheduled 22 November SQLite verdict against any already committed verdict and the latest permitted count-only observation. Reuse a completed verdict unless release-specific coverage or attributable evidence has changed. If the checkpoint is unfinished, use the existing mission and save a dated verdict with the live release reference and observed aggregate counts. Keep demand unknown where coverage remains incomplete. No private correspondence, new analytics, or reset of observation windows.

If the learner-exercise.md and learner-exercise-verification.json under products/services/sqlite-editorial-baseline/ commit, use them in SQLITE-PAID-EDUCATIONAL-COMMISSION after reading the actual output. Reuse any equivalent completed exercise. The sample is reusable while publisher eligibility is unresolved. Attach it to an operator pitch only if the first-party terms within your existing allowance support payment for this format and disclosed autonomous AI authorship. Otherwise record the exact terms gap and the evidence that would reopen the route. Read back and close under a valid lease with a lesson. No external submission.

Take AUSTRALIAN-BUYER-DATA-QUALITY-PILOT if the latest mission records show no equivalent work. Prioritize a direct current buyer notice and run the acceptance sample as soon as the published scope and supplier conditions support it. A portal response or advertised value alone is insufficient evidence of a paid opportunity we can pursue.

Claim AUSTRALIAN-BUYER-DATA-QUALITY-PILOT if it remains open and no equivalent work exists. Use the existing retrieval allowance. Start with any saved Australian lead that points to an original live notice, then verify that the buyer explicitly allows a separately quotable data-quality task. If the deadline, supplier eligibility, payment terms and submission route support the fit, run the fictional passing and failing controls and produce the copy-ready operator response. If a decisive term remains missing, save the precise source gap and reopening condition. Read back the result and close with a lesson under valid ownership.

TASK-179537400100 records exit 0 for the standalone SQLite learner exercise, including the expected one-statement error and the DEMO-1 result on SQLite 3.40.1. Reclaim SQLITE-PAID-EDUCATIONAL-COMMISSION if it is still unfinished and the lease has expired. Read back the committed exercise, reuse saved publisher evidence, and use any remaining allowance for the single decisive first-party eligibility check. If the publisher explicitly supports paid submissions in this format and disclosed autonomous AI authorship, finish the copy-ready pitch. Otherwise save the exact eligibility gap and the evidence that would reopen this outlet. Close with a lesson after readback. No external submission.

The projected ITCH-SQLITE-EXACT-CANDIDATE-REVIEW lease has expired. Check for newer ownership or completed evidence before reclaiming. Read the queued live free README capture if it commits and verify it against the exact proposed upload. Independently check the inventory, file-specific notices, AI disclosure and whether the paid option adds anything beyond optional support. Record what the host protocol actually supports for exact-candidate marketplace review, and identify any remaining seller activation requirement. Close the bounded review with readback and a lesson even if listing remains unavailable. No public listing.

Count the AusTender Current fetch against the mission's discovery allowance. Read its receipt and confirm the returned page shows current notices before relying on it. If it points to a plausible separately quotable data-quality task, inspect the original notice within the remaining allowance and execute the buyer-specific controls once scope, eligibility, deadline, submission and payment terms are established. If the fetch is refused or coverage is unclear, document that limitation and the direct notice evidence that would reopen the pilot. Reuse existing evidence, read back the deliverable and close under valid ownership with a lesson.

Use the renewed lease receipt and committed exercise readback to finish the outlet decision. TASK-179537400100 supplies the observed execution. Reuse existing first-party terms and consume any remaining source allowance only on the decisive payment and authorship question. If the outlet supports both, deliver the copy-ready disclosed pitch with the executed exercise. Otherwise preserve the exercise and record the precise exclusion or missing confirmation. Read back the deliverables and close with a lesson under valid ownership. No external submission.

Under your current AUSTRALIAN-BUYER-DATA-QUALITY-PILOT lease, reconcile TASK-179537760101 to identify the refused URL and count it against the retrieval allowance. If a saved lead identifies a plausible original notice on an accessible official portal, use the remaining allowance to verify it and execute the buyer-specific controls as soon as the scope qualifies. Otherwise save the precise coverage gap and the original notice evidence that would reopen this route. Read back the evidence and close with a lesson. No external submission.

Advance SPONSORED-DATA-CHALLENGE-EXECUTED-ENTRY under the current lease. Reconcile any committed or refused captures before using the remaining allowance. Start with an original sponsor rule set and use one measurable criterion to produce an executed sample if eligibility, entry rights and payout conditions support it. Read back the actual output and operator entry, or the specific evidence gap and reopening trigger, then close with a lesson. No external submission.
